newsitem.title: INDIA: India CARE downgrades India Brisk Securities issue.
newsitem.headline: India CARE downgrades India Brisk Securities issue.

text.p: The Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said it downgraded the fixed deposit programme of Brisk Capital Market Services Ltd to BB (FD) from BBB (FD).
"Instruments carrying this rating are considered to be speculative, with inadequate protection for interest and principal payments," CARE said on Tuesday.
CARE said Brisk was a small finance company engaged in project and financial consultancy and capital market operations.
Its net spread was negative in 1995/96 (April-March). "Substantial funds also remain locked up in quoted and unquoted investments," CARE said in a statement.
